g.text: Parented to the vehicle at socket (1.7274, 1.0475, 0.0914) m —
removals and replacements are pit actions; the hub stays on the vehicle.
Removing keeps this tyre's own pressure, temperature, wear and grip
in the pit bay; fitting returns the same used tyre.
Grip = thermal fade from 80 °C to 200 °C, times the fractional
cold-pressure deviation and the compound grip scale.
